world_rationale: Fresh initial quality acceptance for the whole current world, bound to candidate ebbce847a7f25961af9d67701997f325a73eab1f5f7eacf0ef3f0d4623201485. I inspected the 352 displayed pairs/results/explanations, all 252 concept labels/descriptions, the eight recognizable starters, all 12 progressively unlocked supply groups, all 32 optional goal titles/targets and ten compatible mechanics books. Their exact complete records match V1.13 docs/reviews/v1-13-weather-and-landscape/native/world/candidate.json and the own previous world review docs/reviews/v1-13-weather-and-landscape/native/world/quality-review.json (SHA256 5dcb3990c6773f13546b7cdaa938c14eaf12443fde1f864e3f56ced7e0535610). Flour plus water gives dough, water plus salt gives brine, and water plus cornmeal gives mamaliga: multiple intuitive openings support useful intermediates before bread, bulz and the later dishes. Fruit-to-compote/jam and dough-to-filled/baked-food alternatives form nameable paths; supplies progress from pantry to lunch, pastry and wider menus, while goal titles fit the resulting dishes. The world explicitly explains that pairs express the idea of a dish rather than its complete cooking recipe; unchanged explanations supply omitted preparation, so the simplification is honest. Specific sense definitions for kataif, sweet whipping cream, edible fish and the hot-chocolate variant prevent a newly introduced label ambiguity. Existing closure, supplies, recipe choices, goals and compatibility semantics are unchanged; this is fresh semantic acceptance, not a runtime closure/save-replay claim. Current pack SHA256 e24eb3622c81f3bb0425f975bf74ec3b5a50f9cb719544794704541dc65ff5d8 is unchanged, current rankings SHA256 2660a5e1a62264af3694afda5af71e39001ecea1a39a0e29d5df3f26679e57c6 and catalog SHA256 84b2e0486626b77c0f8a9276b7cbbd79688e71c5c56a09352af8bf1b5f39cbb4 have unchanged board payloads and fresh KG/source binding metadata. The world candidate itself binds current KG, source, rubric and exact previous world; a new audit/final pair must still bind and test the current pack/ranking bytes in 4e. Nothing here waives key/alias/owner holds or qualifies content, installation or serving.
